meaning:
προ-βαίνω
[in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא ;]
to go forwards, go on, advance: Mat.4:21, Mrk.1:19. Metaphorical, of age (Gen.18:11, al., Lys., Diod., al.), ἐν τ. ἡμέραις, Luk.1:7, 18 2:36.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. He…
Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John, his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.
But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they both were well advanced in years.
